outer_protocol.primary_metric: unweighted mean of fold-level test pair_micro_f1
outer_protocol.selection_data: the target fold's official validation labels only
outer_protocol.test_use: one evaluation after the variant and threshold are frozen

task.unit: review x candidate aspect x candidate sentiment
task.prediction_rule: emit every candidate pair whose applicability score meets the selected threshold; emit an empty set if none meet it

candidate_text.control: canonical aspect name plus candidate sentiment only
candidate_text.enhanced: the same canonical name, frozen aspect definition, frozen lexical cues, boundary note, and candidate sentiment definition
candidate_text.description_source: written once from canonical taxonomy names before model execution; no validation/test reviews, labels, predictions, or error analysis used

enhanced_negative_policy: both wrong sentiments for the same gold aspect
one absent hard aspect with the same sentiment; same-parent sibling first, otherwise frozen description-similarity nearest aspect
one deterministic random absent aspect with the same sentiment
training_manifest.budget_sampling: deterministic aspect-balanced round-robin, then seeded fill
training_manifest.reason_for_budget: keep the exact training-pair budget shared by TF-IDF, DistilBERT, and the 8 GB QLoRA pilot

distilbert.head: binary sequence classification
distilbert.checkpoint_selection: highest validation pair_micro_f1; pair_samples_f1 then precision then lower epoch as tie-breakers

qwen.task_format: single candidate aspect-sentiment claim; one-token Y/N answer
qwen.score: softmax probability of Y over Y and N next-token logits
qwen.quantisation: NF4 with double quantisation and float16 compute

threshold_selection.grid: 0.01 to 0.99 inclusive in 0.01 steps, plus every unique midpoint between adjacent validation scores

report: mean, median, standard deviation, minimum and maximum
conditional sentiment accuracy and macro F1 with denominator

isolation.admission: results remain experimental until the user explicitly approves integration
